final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) as matched_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(matched_count) as avg_count FROM side_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT dealedge, matched_count, (matched_count - avg_calc.avg_count) as excess FROM side_counts, avg_calc WHERE matched_count > avg_calc.avg_count) SELECT SUM(matched_count) as total_count, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
